name: @cratefolk/worker
description: Cloudflare Workers deployment of Cratefolk. Not an npm workspace on purpose: the Docker build never installs wrangler.

scripts.dev: npm run migrations && wrangler d1 migrations apply cratefolk --local && wrangler dev
scripts.db:create: wrangler d1 create cratefolk && wrangler r2 bucket create cratefolk-covers && wrangler queues create cratefolk-sync
scripts.db:migrate: npm run migrations && wrangler d1 migrations apply cratefolk --remote
scripts.predeploy: npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate
